statements.chinese: 首先，我喝了太多软饮料
statements.english: First , I drink too many soft drinks

statements.chinese: 我爱喝软饮料，因为它们味道太棒了！
statements.english: I love soft drinks because they taste so good !

statements.chinese: 但软饮料通常含有大量糖分
statements.english: But soft drinks usually have a lot of sugar
Second , I don't drink enough water
I drink water when I am thirsty

statements.chinese: 我口渴时会喝水，但最好在
statements.english: I drink water when I am thirsty , but it's better to drink

statements.chinese: 我口渴时会喝水，但在感到口渴之前喝水更好
statements.english: I drink water when I am thirsty , but it's better to drink before I get thirsty
In future , I should drink more water
